features.dx_rationale: Keeps Lean vocabulary and semantics visible.

features.surface: erased x := e; erased mut x := e; erased x ← action inside do notation
features.lowering: preserve through the reference Lean profile; standalone implementations preserve verification-only binding/erasure semantics
features.dx_rationale: Provides Lean-native verification-only state and a semantic reference point for future ProofScript ghost syntax.

features.surface: monotonicity_by <tactic> on coinductive or relevant mixed inductive/coinductive declarations
features.lowering: preserve/defer in the reference profile; standalone support must enforce Lean 4.34 contextual placement and tactic elaboration
features.dx_rationale: Keeps new Lean coinductive proof control available without inventing a second ProofScript-specific spelling.

features.lowering: preserve/defer; standalone support compares against the existing declaration by definitional equality without mutating the environment
features.dx_rationale: Useful checked documentation/restatement behavior with no new logical declaration.

features.surface: lia [...] and grobner [...] tactic parameter lists
features.dx_rationale: Tracks the current Lean tactic surface without broadening ProofScript term-level bracket ownership.

features.lowering: left-associated Lean application; f() lowers to f ()
features.dx_rationale: Highest-value TypeScript familiarity with minimal semantic risk.

features.surface: (x : A, y : B) in registered declaration headers
features.lowering: ordered sequence of explicit Lean binders
features.dx_rationale: Makes function/declaration headers familiar without TypeScript generics.

features.surface: ; after supported expression-bodied declarations or as separator in registered bodies
features.dx_rationale: Improves editability and familiar statement endings where safe.

features.lowering: contextual declaration-head alias to Lean def with no explicit declaration parameter group
features.dx_rationale: Immediately recognizable value declaration for TypeScript developers.

features.lowering: contextual declaration-head alias to Lean def with at least one explicit declaration parameter group
features.dx_rationale: Recognizable named function declaration while preserving Lean def semantics.

features.canonical_lean: if c then t else e
features.lowering: E-class braced conditional with one term per branch
features.compatibility_cost: The same braces can be Lean term syntax elsewhere; .ps owns this exact if context.

features.lowering: outer braces and member semicolons lower to native structure body layout
features.compatibility_cost: Lean uses braces for implicit structure fields; .ps owns only the outer body delimiter after where.
features.dx_rationale: Makes datatype declarations much more familiar.

features.lowering: outer braces and member semicolons lower to native class/structure body layout

features.dx_rationale: Clear ADT-like shape without changing Lean inductives.

features.lowering: outer braces and alternative semicolons lower to native match alternative sequence
features.compatibility_cost: Brace/semicolon presentation differs from Lean source.
features.dx_rationale: Familiar block around alternatives while preserving Lean match vocabulary.
